2. By means of the present
application, the applicant seeks grant of
anticipatory bail in connection with FIR
dated 17.03.2023 being FIR No. 111 of
2023, registered at Police Station Kotwali
Dehradun, for the offences punishable
under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468 and
471 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. A Coordinate Bench of this Court,
vide order dated 23.11.2023, granted
interim anticipatory bail to the applicant.
In compliance with the conditions
stipulated therein, the applicant has
duly cooperated with the investigation as
and when called upon by the
Investigating Officer.
4. It has been brought to the notice of
this Court that the investigation has
since been concluded and the charge-sheet has already been submitted before
the competent Court.
Learned counsel for the applicant
submits that pursuant to the interim
protection granted by this Court, the
applicant has cooperated throughout the
investigation and has not misused the
liberty granted to him. It is further
submitted that the investigation has

2026:UHC:7282
culminated in the submission of the
charge-sheet and, therefore, no custodial
interrogation of the applicant is required
at this stage.
5. Per contra, learned State Counsel
opposes the anticipatory bail application.
However, he does not dispute that the
applicant has cooperated during the
course of investigation and that the
charge-sheet has already been filed
before the competent Court.
6. Having heard learned counsel for
the parties, perused the material
available on record, and considering the
facts and circumstances of the case, this
Court finds that the applicant has
remained protected by virtue of the
interim order dated 23.11.2023 and has
duly complied with the conditions
incorporated therein by extending full
cooperation during the course of the
investigation. The investigation has
culminated in the submission of the
charge-sheet before the competent
Court. No material has been placed
before this Court to indicate that the
applicant has either misused the liberty
granted to him or failed to cooperate
with the investigating agency. It is also
not the case of the prosecution that the
custodial interrogation of the applicant
is required at this stage.
7. Having regard to the nature of the
allegations, the stage of the proceedings,
the conduct of the applicant during the
period of interim protection, and the
overall facts and circumstances of the
case, and without expressing any
opinion on the merits of the prosecution
case, this Court is of the considered
opinion that the applicant has made out
a fit case for confirmation of the interim
anticipatory bail granted vide order
dated 23.11.2023.
8. Consequently, the interim

anticipatory bail granted to the applicant
vide order dated 23.11.2023 is hereby
confirmed and made absolute. The
applicant shall remain on anticipatory
bail on the same terms and conditions
as contained in the aforesaid order and
shall continue to cooperate with the trial
proceedings. It shall also be open to the
learned Trial Court to impose such
further conditions, if considered
necessary, in accordance with law.
9. Accordingly, the present
Anticipatory Bail Application stands
allowed.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
